description: Remove duplicate records from NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) input. With no keyField, two lines are duplicates when their parsed JSON values are structurally identical. With a keyField, two lines are duplicates when that field's value matches, keeping the first occurrence of each key.

input.description: NDJSON content: one JSON value per line

keyField.description: Optional field name to dedupe by instead of exact structural equality

name: dedupe_ndjson
